name: Saints & Sinners
about: Monastic chant and the Delta's blues, with Ireland between them. Saints light the screen; Sinners darken it.

pieces.name: Glendalough
pieces.about: Kevin's monastery between two lakes: a choir held on D, a cantor low, three quick notes rocking into each long one, a glass bell, a stone church's long room. The Dies irae's first line its air.

pieces.name: Rocky Road
pieces.about: The Rocky Road to Dublin, a slip jig in 9/8: a bodhran driving every eighth, a bouzouki's ta-ta-ta-DUM into each bar, a voice with the tune. One, two, three, four, five.

pieces.name: Iona
pieces.about: Columba's island: a harmonium on G, a harp, a flute over the sound, the surf below.

pieces.name: Crossroads
pieces.about: Delta blues on E, one chord, five notes: a hammered dulcimer for the bar-room piano, shuffling ta-TUM, a plucked bass walking under it, a slide bending up into every note.

pieces.name: Vespers
pieces.about: Evening office: a choir on E minor, a voice above it, glass far off, rain on the roof.

pieces.name: Banshee
pieces.about: The bean sí keening at the window: a voice sliding down D Phrygian, dark strings a semitone apart, a heartbeat, the wind.

pieces.name: The Braes
pieces.about: The Braes of Balquhither, the old song behind Wild Mountain Thyme: a harp in threes, a fiddle, the hill air.

pieces.name: Juke Joint
pieces.about: Saturday night, and the session has found the blues: a bouzouki running a jig's triplets on A with the seventh flat, a bodhran on every one, a fiddle full of rolls.
